messages:
Ana (People Ops): Quick ping: final self-eval deadline is 2026-05-15 11:59pm PT. Managers: please lock manager summaries by 2026-05-22 so we can schedule calibration the week after. Link: https://go/redwood/perf-deadlines :calendar:

Diego (People Ops): New manager checklist added to the doc: 1) confirm goals, 2) add anonymized evidence bullets, 3) recommended rating + rationale, 4) flag timezone issues. Use the checklist when you upload manager summaries.

Priya (Eng Manager): Question: do we need to include comp rationale in the manager summary or keep compensation conversations after calibration?

Ana (People Ops): Keep comp rationale out of the initial manager summary. Panels evaluate impact and evidence. Comp notes go into the post-calibration compensation worksheet handled by People Ops & Finance.

Sam (IC): If I submit my self-eval late because of travel, will my manager still be able to include my case in calibration?

Diego (People Ops): Late submissions are allowed but managers must request exception via this quick form: https://go/redwood/perf-exception. We need manager approval + People Ops sign-off to include late cases in panels. Try to avoid last-minute uploads.

PulseBot: Reminder: Manager summaries due in 7 days for teams >4 directs. Please upload to: https://go/redwood/manager-upload :bell:

Ana (People Ops): Paste-ready 1-line for manager invites: "Please review attached pre-reads before calibration. Bring 2 talking points per review (impact, development). We'll timebox to 12 mins per person."
